Supplier shall provide Buyer with advance shipping notification not less than 21 days prior to the scheduled ship date. Buyer shall inspect each shipment within sixty (60) days of receipt and shall notify Supplier in writing of any discrepancy in quantity or apparent damage, failing which the shipment shall be deemed accepted as delivered. Supplier shall retain records of each shipment's packing list and carrier manifest for a period of not less than sixty (60) days, and shall make such records available to Buyer upon reasonable written request for the purpose of resolving any delivery dispute. Title to rejected goods shall remain with Supplier pending disposition instructions from Supplier, which shall be provided within 21 days of receiving notice of rejection.

Supplier warrants that the custom wiring harnesses delivered under this Agreement shall, for a period of thirty (30) days from the date of delivery, conform to the specifications set out in Schedule 1 and shall be free from defects in material and workmanship under normal use and service. This warranty does not extend to defects arising from misuse, unauthorized modification, or normal wear and tear. Buyer's sole and exclusive remedy for breach of this warranty shall be, at Supplier's option, repair, replacement, or refund of the purchase price for the nonconforming goods, provided that Buyer notifies Supplier in writing within 21 days of discovering the defect. Supplier shall bear the cost of shipping any repaired or replacement goods to Buyer, and Buyer shall grant Supplier reasonable access to inspect the nonconforming goods prior to any repair, replacement, or refund. This warranty is in lieu of all other warranties, express or implied, including any implied warranty of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose, except as expressly set out in this Clause.

Buyer shall pay all undisputed invoices within forty-five (45) days of the invoice date, by wire transfer to the bank account designated by Supplier in writing. Invoices not disputed in writing within 10 days of receipt shall be deemed accepted. Amounts not paid when due shall accrue interest at the rate of one and one-half percent (1.5%) per month, or the maximum rate permitted by applicable law, whichever is lower. All amounts payable under this Agreement are exclusive of applicable value-added, sales, or similar taxes, which shall be borne by Buyer unless otherwise required by law. Buyer may withhold payment of any invoiced amount that is subject to a good-faith dispute, provided Buyer notifies Supplier in writing of the basis for the dispute within 10 days of receipt of the invoice, and the parties shall use reasonable efforts to resolve the dispute within forty-five (45) days. Neither party shall be entitled to set off amounts owed under this Agreement against amounts owed under any other agreement between the parties absent written agreement to the contrary.

Confidential Information disclosed under this Agreement shall be used by the receiving party solely for the purpose of performing its obligations hereunder, and shall be protected using at least the same degree of care that the receiving party uses to protect its own confidential information of similar importance, but in no event less than a reasonable degree of care. Upon termination of this Agreement, each party shall, within forty-five (45) days of the other party's written request, return or destroy all Confidential Information in its possession, except to the extent retention is required by applicable law or bona fide archival policy. Neither party shall use the other party's Confidential Information to develop products or services that compete with the disclosing party's business, and each party acknowledges that unauthorized disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages would be an inadequate remedy, entitling the disclosing party to seek injunctive relief in addition to any other available remedy.

Neither party shall be liable for any failure or delay in the performance of its obligations under this Agreement, other than payment obligations, to the extent such failure or delay is caused by circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including acts of God, war, civil unrest, governmental action, pandemic, or failure of utilities or telecommunications infrastructure, provided that the affected party notifies the other party in writing within 14 days of the onset of such circumstances and uses commercially reasonable efforts to mitigate the impact. If such circumstances continue for more than thirty (30) days, either party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice. During the continuation of an event of force majeure, the unaffected party may, at its option and upon written notice, procure substitute goods or services from a third party to the extent reasonably necessary to mitigate the impact of the affected party's non-performance, without thereby waiving any right or remedy under this Agreement.

Any improvements, modifications, or derivative works created by Supplier in the course of manufacturing the industrial control modules that relate specifically to Buyer's proprietary designs shall be owned by Buyer, and Supplier hereby assigns all right, title, and interest in such improvements to Buyer. Supplier represents that it maintains a code of conduct consistent with generally accepted standards for responsible sourcing and shall not employ forced labor or child labor in the manufacture of the industrial control modules. Supplier shall notify Buyer in writing within 14 days of becoming aware of any material non-compliance with applicable law in Singapore, and shall implement a corrective action plan within 30 days of identifying such non-compliance, subject to Buyer's reasonable approval. Buyer may, at its discretion and upon reasonable written notice, request evidence of Supplier's compliance with this Clause from any sub-tier supplier involved in the manufacture of the industrial control modules, and Supplier shall use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain and provide such evidence within 14 days.

Supplier's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall be capped at 100% of the annual Contract Value; in no event shall Supplier be liable for consequential, incidental, or indirect damages of any kind arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, whether in contract, tort, or otherwise.
